summary: Inferring task failure from a non-zero rc without an explicit failed value is deprecated; modules must set failed true or use fail_json, and runtime warnings start in 2.22.
questions: Will Ansible still mark a task failed just because rc is non-zero?
How should my custom module report failure in ansible-core 2.21?
When will rc-based failure inference warnings appear?

answer_card.title: Failure inference from non-zero rc is deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
Modules and actions that return a non-zero `rc` without a `failed` value currently get treated as failed. This inference is **deprecated**.

Modules can still use any logic (including `rc`) to decide failure, but must report it explicitly by setting `failed: true`, calling `fail_json`, or raising an unhandled error. Runtime deprecation warnings start in **2.22**; once removed, `rc` gets no special treatment in result processing.
